encounter_map.name: encounter_map
encounter_map.where: "encounter"."visibility" = 'public' and not "encounter"."hidden" and "encounter"."deleted_at" is null and "encounter"."location_size" is not null

encounter_location.name: encounter_location
encounter_location.value: ("encounter"."location_size" is null and "encounter"."location_x" is null and "encounter"."location_y" is null) or ("encounter"."location_size" is not null and "encounter"."location_x" is not null and "encounter"."location_y" is not null and "encounter"."location_size" in (500,1000,2000) and "encounter"."location_x" between 0 and 2600 and "encounter"."location_y" between 3000 and 14500)

media_dimensions.name: media_dimensions
media_dimensions.value: "media"."state" <> 'ready' or ("media"."width" is not null and "media"."height" is not null and "media"."width" between 1 and 1920 and "media"."height" between 1 and 1920)

friendship_state.name: friendship_state
friendship_state.value: ("friendship"."state"='pending' and "friendship"."accepted_at" is null) or ("friendship"."state"='accepted' and "friendship"."accepted_at" is not null)
